hero.title: #SoMuchAbility
hero.subtitle: Empowering people with Down syndrome, autism, and neurodiversity in Hong Kong through sport, nutrition, family support, and holistic community care.

fourDoors.title: Where will you begin?

education.description: Grow life skills, join inclusive programmes, and access family care across sport, nutrition, and support.

donate.title: Donate & Partner
donate.description: Fund nutrition packs, blood testing, coaching sessions, and day-to-day community care.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.description: Share your time supporting weekly classes, family sessions, and inclusive community events.

calendar.title: Activity Calendar
calendar.description: Find upcoming sports, nutrition workshops, family programmes, and community gatherings.

jamie.quote: Delivering my first TEDx talk proved to everyone that having Down syndrome never limits what you can express and contribute.

chris.quote: Working independently in food service and community outreach, gaining confidence and financial independence.

mei.quote: Overcoming health challenges through tailored nutrition and sports classes, now mentoring younger neurodiverse peers.

philosophy.body: We focus entirely on what our community CAN do — unlocking potential through sports, nutrition, and lifelong empowerment.
